review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: Extends the existing Z-Girl facilitator authorization, credential registry, verification, renewal, and Train-the-Trainer architecture with a governed Professional Support specialization. Public credential activation, paid launch, provider matching, clinical service delivery, and professional workspace entitlements remain locked pending owner approval and required compliance/QA.

ai_uses.purpose: Professional-support pathway architecture, training/credential specialization design, participant-controlled handoff design, safety/privacy boundary definition, commercial product-layer design, and release preparation
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: AI accelerates a coherent extension of the existing Z-Girl credential ecosystem while preserving human professional authority and participant choice
ai_uses.human_oversight: Independent professional qualifications remain externally governed; Z-Girl only verifies program competency; participant sharing remains consent-driven; owner retains release and commercial approval
ai_uses.provenance: Application and governance implementation in lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach on factory/professional-support-credential-pathway; built on existing Z-Girl v2.7-v2.9 credential and Train-the-Trainer architecture

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Clinical authority, professional licensure, safeguarding decisions, credential issuance, and public/paid activation must remain human-governed.

evidence: Professional Support pathway presents a clear six-stage user journey and premium Z-Girl commercial language
The experience reuses the existing brand system rather than creating a parallel product
AI is positioned as preparation and workflow support rather than professional replacement
The pathway explicitly separates Z-Girl competency from external professional authority
Participant-controlled sharing and human-first professional handoff are central to the design
The architecture supports safer access to qualified human support without presenting AI as therapy
Verify Release passed on the initial candidate
Existing credential verification and Train-the-Trainer surfaces are reused as the underlying system
Primary pathway uses text-first semantic sections and explicit role/scope language
Participant control and privacy boundaries are written in plain language
Z-Girl human-first doctrine and existing credential hierarchy are preserved
No new source of truth, credential registry, or training platform is introduced
Professional qualification and Z-Girl program authorization remain separate
No private reflection access is granted by credential status alone
Provider matching, clinical care, paid activation, and public credential issuance remain locked

exceptions: Professional credential naming and claims require final legal/compliance review before public activation.

Live provider discovery, virtual counseling connections, booking, clinical messaging, clinical records, provider compensation/referral economics, and paid professional workspace access are not activated in this release candidate.
